as_told.title: Harrington's months-long briefing: the aliens were 'like day three'

plain: A former US government official named John S. Herrington is said to have been briefed for months in an underground facility in West Virginia, around 1981. Brent Friedman, a man who knew him, tells Michels what Herrington told him: "I was briefed for months in an underground facility in West Virginia." In a later episode Friedman adds that when he asked about it, Herrington said seeing the aliens came only around "day three" of the briefing, which, if true, would mean a senior official was shown alien beings in a secret government setting.
